text:
Predicates:
SupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is a supervised learning algorithm.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is an unsupervised learning algorithm.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is a reinforcement learning algorithm.
UsedToTrain(x, y) ::: x is used to train y.
TrainWithLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
TextSummarizationModel(y) ::: y is a text summarization model.

Premises:
∀x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) → ¬UsedToTrain(x, textSummarizationModel)) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
∃x (UsedToTrain(x, textSummarizationModel) ∧ UnsupervisedLearning(x)) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms, which may include unsupervised learning.
¬∃x (ReinforcementLearning(x) ∧ UsedToTrain(x, textSummarizationModel)) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the text summarization model.
∀x (UsedToTrain(x, textSummarizationModel) → TrainWithLabelledData(x)) ::: The ML algorithm for training the model requires labelled data.

Conclusion:
∃x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) ∧ UsedToTrain(x, textSummarizationModel)) ::: Unsupervised learning is used to train the text summarization model.
